narrative: Согласно событию E041, реальные заработные платы в России за год снижаются на 10 %. Main quantity: ru.real_wage (реальная заработная плата, индекс в % к предыдущему периоду / уровень). The event asserts a 10 % decline in real wages over one year. The sign is negative (падение). The base forecast of the macro model (p50) shows ru.real_wage at 474.507 in log100 scale by month 12 (2027-09), essentially flat over the horizon. A 10 % fall translates to a shift of 100·ln(0.9) ≈ −10.54 in log100, giving a target level of ≈ 463.97. The condition is placed at month 12 with bounds 462.0–466.0 (±2.0 log100, roughly ±2 % in levels), reflecting uncertainty about the exact timing and magnitude of the fall within the year. The mechanism is not specified in the event; the models then derive the adjustment path of other macro variables and, through the regressor ru.real_wage, the satellite quantities housing_price_primary and housing_price_secondary.
